Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 134. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Weapon Technique
Ki Cost: 30 Ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Ranged
Weapon that you are proficient with
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Weapon’s Range
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: Yes
You load the best ammunition you have access to or
pour all your ki into the projectile before firing it. Make
a ranged Combo Attack, when you would make this
attack, you ignore all form of bonus to AC from
techniques or spells. On a hit, you deal your weapon’s
damage + 5d6
